name: io.github.dimitar-grigorov/mcp-file-tools
title: MCP File Tools
description: Cross-platform MCP file tools with cwd_id relative path mode, complete single-response JSON output, and safe refactor helpers

tools.name: set_cwd
tools.description: Register one absolute directory and receive a small cwd_id for cwd-relative path calls

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one absolute or cwd-relative file or line range as compact line-numbered text with JSON metadata

tools.name: read_files
tools.description: Batch-read absolute or cwd-relative files and line ranges with coverage, continuation, literal output by default, and explicit strict redaction

tools.name: outline_file
tools.description: Inspect one absolute or cwd-relative file as a compact language-aware outline plus stable fingerprint and selectors. Agent profile hides TSX local variable noise and JSON/YAML value/wrapper noise while keeping key paths; full/filters expose details

tools.name: resolve_symbol_range
tools.description: Resolve outline selectors or enclosing lines to concrete ranges and prepared dry-run copy/move recommendations

tools.name: copy_ranges
tools.description: Copy exact line ranges from one absolute or cwd-relative source file into one explicit target with fingerprints, dry-run, diff preview, joiner diagnostics, validation/read-back, and optional backup; verify escape-sensitive edits with read_file

tools.name: move_ranges
tools.description: Move exact line ranges from one absolute or cwd-relative source file into one explicit target with target/source diff preview and read-back validation; verify escape-sensitive edits with read_file

tools.name: copy_ranges_batch
tools.description: Copy exact line ranges from one absolute or cwd-relative source snapshot into multiple explicit targets with per-target structured results

tools.name: move_ranges_batch
tools.description: Move exact line ranges from one absolute or cwd-relative source snapshot into multiple explicit targets and remove source ranges once

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List direct children of one absolute or cwd-relative directory as JSON entries

tools.name: glob_file_search
tools.description: Recursively find files under one absolute or cwd-relative directory by glob pattern with sort, continuation, hidden flags, JSON matches, and bounded read/outline next calls

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Agent-friendly grep under one absolute or cwd-relative path with literal/regex modes, search stats, file groups, read ranges, and schema-valid read/outline next calls

tools.name: inspect_path
tools.description: Inspect one absolute or cwd-relative file-system path as JSON metadata

tools.name: workspace_inventory
tools.description: Build a directories-only JSON inventory tree/page/summary with directory-level glob hints and explicit page vs summary/tree coverage fields
